---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv('../final_data/Combined_Results_by_Cell_2023_2024.csv')
```

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  select(GRID_ID, Year, Month, Actual_Crash_Count, RF_Predicted_Crashes,
         GB_Predicted_Crashes, XGB_Predicted_Crashes)
```

```{r}
predicted_data <- data %>%
  rename(Random_Forest = RF_Predicted_Crashes,
         Gradient_Boosting = GB_Predicted_Crashes,
         XGBoost = XGB_Predicted_Crashes,
         Actual = Actual_Crash_Count) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Random_Forest, Gradient_Boosting, XGBoost, Actual),
    names_to = 'Model',
    values_to = 'Predicted_Crashes')
```

```{r}
dated_data <- predicted_data %>%
  mutate(YearMonth = make_date(year = Year, month = Month))
```

```{r}
data_1957 <- dated_data %>%
  filter(GRID_ID == 1957)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data_1957, aes(x = YearMonth, y = Predicted_Crashes, color = Model)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#DCAB6B', '#B48291', '#A5CCD1', '#495159')) +
  scale_x_date(
    limits = as.Date(c('2023-01-01', '2024-12-01')),
    date_breaks = '3 months', date_labels = '%b %Y',
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.001)) +
  labs(x = 'Month', y = 'Crash Count') +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 25)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = 'none') 
```
